about: Numbers behind label-snap-within1.svg and label-snap-community.svg, copied from label_snap_checks in docs/results.json (rounded where the release did not already publish them). Model output: geometry, never a reading.
credit: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0 (the scans the tests read); numbers from docs/results.json

within1.claim_label: Model output: share of surface label vertices within 1 voxel of the recto face of an independent finer scan, fresh sites, each test's rule fixed before it ran

community.claim_label: Model output: mean distance gained toward a finer scan's recto face over the published label, label-scan voxels, 71 fresh PHerc0814 and PHerc0841 sites pooled, 95 % site bootstrap intervals, rule fixed before the run

rows.name: One fixed offset for every vertex (reference)
vc_objrefine port, thresholds tuned on PHerc0139

community.notes: The fixed offset moves every vertex by labelsnap's median move (about 1.85 voxels toward the recto), so it shows how much of the gain a single shift gives. Midline and nearest-peak snaps aim at the sheet center by design, so part of their loss is the target, not error.
